scope: Independent native UI/input/guide/layout checks, plus actual Godot screenshot review. Not device or human comprehension acceptance.

native_accessibility_captures.visual_review: No clipping of menu promise, CTA, subtitle or sheet titles; actual scrolling and fixed sheet actions visible.

findings.issue: Marfa actor overlaps the professor and reads as a partial figure behind him.
Observer feet and several heavy props float in front of the backdrop walls without appropriate visible ground/support.
Permanent capacity0 debug-like badge competes with the task without explaining units or the supporting law.
Natural-size TextureRect minima initially enlarged the moth and cropped the professor.
story_started was discarded and a resumed first-task plan could show Start Story instead of Continue.
Native downsampled illustrations show stronger aliasing than approved browser reference; review mipmaps/filtering.

limits: Screenshots from desktop Godot/Mesa are not physical phone tests.
Automated solutions and readable labels do not prove first-time player understanding or enjoyment.
A full-canvas Stage rectangle does not prove80percent unobscured playfield.
